front.title: A YANG Data Model for ECN Threshold Policies

abstract.t:
This document defines administrative limits and operational state for local ECN threshold adaptation on queues using a single byte-based Random Early Detection (RED) profile. It augments the QoS queue template model with policy bounds and the interface model with confirmed per-queue state.
The policy constrains both RED thresholds, preserves the configured ramp width, and specifies quantization, input validity, transition, and fallback behavior. It does not select a learning algorithm, modify ECN codepoints, reserve physical buffer capacity, or guarantee congestion-control stability or lossless delivery.
